note: Microsoft Learn's 'Lineage in Fabric' article (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/governance/lineage, last updated 2026-04-17 per the page itself) is a single screenshot-dense page covering exactly this lesson's scope: what lineage view shows, the three ways to open it (workspace toolbar, item options menu, item details page), how cards/arrows/icons read, refresh status on nodes, the highlight-lineage interaction, zoom/full-screen, accessibility (keyboard nav + screen readers), the Viewer-role data-source restriction, and the explicit scope limit that cross-workspace downstream items require impact analysis (the subject of lesson 20) instead. Also downloaded but not used in slides.json (kept in source-images/ for reference, not referenced by any slide): lineage-workspace.png (workspace-toolbar entry point icon — options-menu entry point was judged more illustrative and was used instead), lineage-highlight-specific-lineage.png (the highlighted/dimmed canvas after selecting an item's highlight-lineage icon), lineage-data-source-card.png, lineage-data-details.png, and lineage-zoom.png (small UI-chrome crops, lower illustrative value than the three used). This lesson intentionally stops at describing the lineage view itself and does not cover using it to assess a specific planned change's blast radius — that workflow is lesson 20, Impact Analysis in Fabric.
